groups.label: White blooms
groups.blurb: The ivory mass at the top and base — hydrangea for volume, peony for weight.

items.role: Large white clusters along the top of each column — the visual main flower.
Heavy layered white heads at the base, giving the column weight.
Full white peony blooms, opening out among the greenery.
Round-petal white rose heads scattered through the lower section.
Soft layered white ranunculus, the small ruffled blooms.
White phalaenopsis with a visible lip, tucked low on the column.
Round green button balls dotted through the base.

groups.label: Lavender & grey-blue accents
groups.blurb: The cool notes that stop the ivory from reading flat — a muted purple mass and fine filler.

items.role: Grey-lavender hydrangea mass on the right column, dense and clustered.
Soft lilac ranunculus through the middle-left, adding depth.

groups.label: Foliage & grasses
groups.blurb: The fine trailing greenery that gives this display its soft, forest-like edge — asparagus fern is the soul of this look.

items.role: Fine airy trailing foliage in large mass — the signature of this display, creating the soft misty forest feel.
Round-leaf and fine-leaf eucalyptus with berry tops, adding grey-toned depth.
Fluffy massed needle leaves filling the lower layer.
Long berry-bearing branches reaching up past the top of the columns.
Light misty strands adding airy filler and movement.
